question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct option is: **Branches**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The context tells us about the tree branches that occasionally cast deep black shadows on the ground.
 
• The word "branches" fits the blank as it refers to the parts of the trees, specifically their limbs or extensions, which would cast shadows across the ground.
 
• This choice aligns with the context of the passage, where the scene describes trees and shadows.

Hence, the correct answer is: **Branches**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Pack (झुंड):** This refers to a collection or group of things, often used for animals or objects. It does not fit here, as it does not relate to the image of trees casting shadows.
 
• **Material(सामग्री):** This refers to the substance or components of something. It doesn't make sense in this context because it doesn't relate to trees or shadows.
 
• **Transition (परिवर्तन):** This refers to a process of change or movement from one state to another. It doesn't fit in this context because the passage is describing trees and their physical attributes, not a shift in state.

Presently, a soprano voice of richness and depth floated from the open windows of the parlour, resonating *over __*the darkening greenery. All at once it was as if the entire scene before them was *__awakened __*by that voice, infused with unexpected life; the western sky, streaked with bands of pale gold and purple; the two houses, standing grey and disconsolate against that sky; the __***branches ***__of trees casting deep black shadows here and there across the ground. The same voice that (4) ..... everything suddenly to life also drew them into another, much deeper world: a world that was normally hidden, a world that (5) ..... into eternity.
